lines.en: The steel that had grown around us was shielding Lee Jihye and me.
[The constellation ‘Master of Steel’ reveals his Status.]
Lee Hyunsung’s sponsor had originally been ‘Master of Steel.’
But ‘Master of Steel’ had perished during the recent incident in <Oz>.
And had passed his modifier on to someone else.
【King of the Silver Heart.】
King of the Silver Heart. He was the new ‘Master of Steel.’
A being who, like ‘Master of the Sunken Island,’ had seen the Conclusion of the 999th round.
The Lee Hyunsung who had seen the Conclusion of the 999th round.
【Drop this pathetic sponsor act. What are you doing?】
Was it because she was facing another ‘king’? The Lee Jihye of the 999th round was regaining her senses.
【Why did you stay silent when we called, only to show up now?】
‘Master of the Sunken Island’ was speaking.

【You were the one who said we should follow our principles. We promised to reclaim our story, even if we had to become the destruction of other worlds. To take our scenario back from the <Star Stream>… That’s what you said.】
The Stories flowing beside them gave me some idea of their lives.
「Jihye. We must keep our principles. Even if you become an ‘Outer God,’ don’t forget them.」
「When the world hurts you, those principles alone will protect you.」
「They will speak for you and say that you weren’t wrong.」
Just as Lee Jihye is Lee Jihye in every round, Lee Hyunsung is also Lee Hyunsung in every round.
Even after becoming ‘Outer Gods,’ their essence had not changed.
‘King of the Silver Heart’ looked at me.
I couldn’t read the feelings in his gaze.
【This is my principle, Jihye. Not to repeat the tragedy of the 999th round.】
【What nonsense is that? Are principles something you can change on a whim?】
【I heard many things from my sponsor who lived in this worldline. Perhaps…this is the very worldline we have been searching for.】
‘King of the Silver Heart’ was shining coldly.
【A worldline where we can see the ‘end’ of everything.】
At those words, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round hesitated.
【There’s no such worldline. This one is finished anyway. Even if you stop me, even if I stop—】
Apparently, ‘King of the Silver Heart’ had chosen not to become a disaster in this ‘Great Apocalypse.’
I had expected as much. If he had meant to harm us, he would have acted in <Oz>.
In fact, that was why I had brought Lee Hyunsung. As a last card to play, just in case something went wrong.
【They are not so weak. Uriel alone will not be enough.】

When ‘King of the Silver Heart’ spoke, ‘Master of the Sunken Island’ answered. Emptiness lay in her eyes as she gazed at the distant horizon. Then, a moment later, life returned to them. She looked as though she had seen something unpleasant.
【What if she isn’t alone?】
The next moment, pitch-black darkness covered the far horizon.
Something we hadn’t anticipated was appearing beyond it.
The members of <Kim Dokja’s Company> had taken up position in the waters near Dokdo and were waiting for something.

After Kim Dokja vanished toward the Pacific, a sound like distant drums occasionally reached them from beyond the horizon. Each time it sounded, they flinched. No one mentioned those intermittent jolts, but everyone knew what they meant.
‘I want to go help Kim Dokja.’
But they held back. That was the plan. If they acted rashly here, they might lose everything instead of saving Kim Dokja. They had to stick to the plan, no matter what. According to the plan, here…
Rrrrrumble.
That was when heat washed down from the sky. A heat wave covered the entire sea. Looking up instinctively, they saw an unbelievable sight.
Kim Dokja had been right.
「A blazing sun was falling into the middle of the sea.」
From the top of Gong Pildu’s fortress, Han Sooyoung, who was directing the operation, shouted.
“Prepare for battle!”
Heat that seemed capable of melting even a soul.
Within that terrible crimson blaze was the winged Uriel of the 999th round.
【Where is ‘Secretive Plotter’?】
「An Outer God king, ‘The Living Flame’ rising in the east.」

Feeling the immense Status radiating before her, Han Sooyoung swallowed. Or tried to. Even the saliva in her mouth seemed to have dried up; she couldn’t feel a trace of moisture. Clearing her parched throat, she spoke.
“Begin ‘Extinguishing the Flame.’”
Extinguishing the Flame. That was the mission assigned to them, ‘Team One.’
Han Sooyoung recalled Kim Dokja’s final words before he left.
—Don’t kill her. That being is ‘Uriel’ too.
…Damn you, Kim Dokja. Subdue that thing without killing it?
Amid their silent defiance, ‘The Living Flame’ narrowed her eyes.
【If you will not answer—】
“Yoo Sangah!”
At the signal, Yoo Sangah stretched out her hand. A vast mandala rotated among her fluttering Buddhist robes, then shot straight toward the sun.
The strongest debuff skill <Kim Dokja’s Company> currently possessed activated.
[The Story ‘Hour of Mandala’ is activating!]
And, though only slightly, the sun’s activity slowed.
The Uriel of the 999th round muttered.
【…Interference with space and time? Is Sakyamuni here? I cannot sense his presence.】
Rrrrrumble!
She clenched her fist, and the surrounding spacetime shook as though about to shatter.
Blood trickled from Yoo Sangah’s lips.
“This is the best I can do!”
“Jung Heewon! Shin Yoosung!”
At Han Sooyoung’s command, the two rushed forward.
The Uriel of the 999th round spotted Shin Yoosung first.
A huge dragon’s shadow fell across the sea. Its poison breath covered the sun’s infernal flames.
【The ‘Beast Lord’ of this worldline.】
Parts of Uriel’s incarnation body discolored where the breath touched them. But only for an instant. Her skin repaired itself at once.
“Let’s see you block this too!”
At the voice right beside her, the Uriel of the 999th round swung her sword instinctively.
Claaaaang!
[Flames of Retribution] collided with the [Sword of Judgement].
After just one clash, Jung Heewon vomited blood and was forced back.
[The incarnation ‘Jung Heewon’ is activating ‘Hour of Judgement’!]
【‘Hour of Judgement’? How did you use that technique against me?】
“Who knows? How did I?”
[Hell Flames Ignition] enveloped Jung Heewon’s sword. Seeing that and the archangel’s wings extending from her back, the Uriel of the 999th round stiffened and released her Status.
【…So you’re my incarnation.】
As though to oppose her, a constellation’s power manifested in Jung Heewon’s body too.
[Heewon’s my incarnation, not yours, you know?]
The two Uriels clashed, unleashing their Status against each other.
Once, twice. With each clash, Jung Heewon’s face grew rapidly paler.
“How can she be so strong…!”
【I will not fall for those ridiculous memories as I did last time.】
As Jung Heewon was driven onto the defensive in an instant, Uriel shouted urgently.
[■uck! What are you all standing around watching for!]
At the same time, black flames struck the Uriel of the 999th round from behind.
Frowning, ‘The Living Flame’ spoke.
【Black Flame Dragon.】
Having unwound the bandages on both hands, the Black Flame Dragon shouted triumphantly.
[Heh heh, how does that taste, damned angel!]
Absolute Good and Absolute Evil. Two Narrative-grade constellations who had once been sworn enemies were joining forces to stop a disaster.
[Hell Flames Ignition] and [Black Flames] exploded against the sun’s forces. In the dazzling storm of light, Han Sooyoung trembled silently.
‘…She’s strong.’
‘The Living Flame’ was fighting those two powerful constellations with just one hand. Even their combined strength couldn’t overwhelm her.
【Is this all I amount to in this round? Where is <Eden>? Why are you with these people?】
[Eden’s been destroyed, fu■k!]
【…There is no <Eden>? You mean to face me without a nebula’s protection?】
As though they were no longer even worth fighting, ‘The Living Flame’ turned away.
The sunlight intensified, and something began crawling out of the scorching heat. ‘Outer Gods’ who followed her. An army numbering in the thousands awaited her command.
【Go. Find ‘Secretive Plotter.’】
The advance began. Countless ‘Nameless Ones’ with burning wings descended toward the surface. At this rate, they would engulf the Korean Peninsula in an instant.
[The incarnation ‘Shin Yoosung’ is activating ‘Superlative Diverse Communication Lv.???’!]
Shin Yoosung moved.
Countless sea beasts broke through the sea’s surface and leapt up, biting the ankles of the ‘Nameless Ones’ and refusing to let go.

Gong Pildu, the Armed Fortress Master, joined in too. As the automatic turrets installed across the battlements opened fire, the ‘Nameless Ones’ screamed in agony, riddled with holes. The Uriel of the 999th round spoke.
【You even accepted such a wicked human as a companion? Pathetic.】
The ‘Nameless Ones’ pressed relentlessly toward Gong Pildu’s fortress. At last, just as one side of the battlements was about to collapse under the Outer Gods’ attack, Han Sooyoung shouted.
“Lee Gilyoung!”

As though he had been waiting for it, Lee Gilyoung appeared between the battlements. Wrapped in pitch-black Status, he roared toward the sky. A yellow cloud swept in from somewhere and covered the heavens. For a moment, that vast swarm blocked even the scorching sun.
[The constellation ‘Ruler of the Deepest Pit’ bares their white teeth.]
【…The demon god Abaddon? Why are you here?】
Startled by the unexpected enemy, the Uriel of the 999th round growled fiercely.
With Shin Yoosung, Gong Pildu and now Lee Gilyoung joining forces, the battle began to even out.
The yellow locusts Abaddon commanded hurled their bodies forward to hold back the ‘Nameless Ones.’
【Gaaaaaaah!】

The ‘Nameless Ones’ writhed in agony. Frowning, the Uriel of the 999th round easily defended against Uriel and the Black Flame Dragon with one hand while concentrating magic power in the other. She intended to break through the encirclement with [Hell Flames Ignition].
But someone had read her intention first.
“Now! Strike!”
At Han Sooyoung’s signal, a long scythe shot up through the surface of the deep sea.
With a sharp slash, it left a deep cut across the archangel’s wing.
White feathers scattered, and otherworldly Stories spilled out.
【The king of <Underworld>…!】
For the first time, the Uriel of the 999th round wore a completely rigid expression.
[The nebula <Underworld> is releasing its stored Stories!]
Along with Hades, some of <Underworld>’s elite forces crossed through a portal. The Three Judges, and Persephone too.
The ‘Nameless Ones’ escorting the sun crumbled, and <Underworld>’s Status pressed down on the Uriel of the 999th round.
But she held her ground.

The incarnations of Sakyamuni and Uriel, the Abyssal Black Flame Dragon, and now even Hades, a Myth-grade constellation. Though one wing had been torn by a surprise attack and a force on the scale of a substantial nebula had joined the fight, she did not give ground.
If anything, she seemed to be waiting for a chance to turn the tables.
“What are you dawdling for! Hurry up and join in!”
[The constellation ‘Most Ancient Liberator’ stirs as though annoyed.]
Rrrrrumble!
Dark clouds swarmed above the yellow clouds covering the sky. The thunderclouds glowed ominously, flashed blue for an instant, then mercilessly poured lightning onto the sea.
The sky flashed without pause. Between the passing bolts of lightning, a proud constellation came into view.
Disheveled platinum hair.
A Myth-grade constellation with that familiar, arrogant curve to his lips.
The instant the Uriel of the 999th round opened her eyes wide, the Ruyi Jingu Bang filled her vision and smashed into her body.
Unable to withstand the tremendous impact, her incarnation body plunged into the sea with a deafening crash.
“Nice one, Sun Wukong!”
Han Sooyoung shouted excitedly.
Blood bubbled to the sea’s surface. Soon, the Uriel of the 999th round emerged. Had she torn apart every marine creature around her on the way up? Her entire body was drenched in blood.
The expression on her face was wonder rather than betrayal.
【…I cannot believe it. Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal. Even you side with these people?】
Soon, that wonder turned briefly to longing.
Sensing the change, the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal asked.
[Who are you to act like you know me?]
【I merely recalled an old comrade I lost. I have no wish to fight you. Move aside. I want only ‘Secretive Plotter.’】
There truly was no will to fight in her voice.
But the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal shook his head.
[I don’t like that gloomy bastard either.]
Terrifying energy burst from his body as he smiled casually.
[But if he dies, I think our youngest will be in trouble.]
[The constellation ‘Most Ancient Liberator’ reveals his Status!]
A being who had released the Status bound by the Golden Headband and even obtained the power of an Outer God through a partial ‘Outer God Transformation.’
The demons who had participated in the 『Journey to the West Remake』 were descending upon the Pacific through portals.
【MonkeyKingMonkeyKingMonkeyKingMonkeyKing】
‘Outer Gods’ worshipping different kings grappled with one another. Violent waves covered the blood-soaked sea, and the Uriel of the 999th round gasped.
At last, the balanced scales began to tip.
“That’s it. Press the attack!”
At Han Sooyoung’s words, the Giant Stories of <Kim Dokja’s Company> began their stories in unison.
[The Giant Story ‘Demon Realm’s Spring’ begins its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘Torch That Swallowed the Myth’ is beginning its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘Season of Light and Darkness’ begins its story!]
[The Giant Story ‘The Liberator of the Forgotten Ones’ begins its story!]
Though the principal tellers, Kim Dokja and Yoo Joonghyuk, were absent, the other members also held considerable shares in the Giant Stories.
And some were preparing the final blow, as though they had been waiting for this moment.
[One sun in the sky is enough.]
Surya appeared with his train. And.
[I’m used to cutting down Outer Gods now.]
[Let us attack together, Breaking the Sky Sword Saint.]
“I’m coming too!”
And the Breaking the Sky Sword Saint, Kyrgios, and even Jang Hayoung joined the fight.
Driven onto the defensive, the Uriel of the 999th round slowly began to look bewildered.
【How…are all of you together? What is this worldline—】
The surging Giant Stories had bewildered her.
Their size was one thing, but the problem was their content. How could Stories like these be possible?
How on earth?

Riding the train, the three Transcenders pierced the sun’s heat shield. [Breaking the Sky Swordsmanship] and [Electrification] shattered the sky, joined by the tremendous destructive force of [Breaking the Sky Force Punch] in a single strike.
Just as that strike was about to hit Uriel where she was unguarded.
An icy sensation swept over the back of Han Sooyoung’s neck.
“Wait!”
[The Story ‘Predictive Plagiarism’ urgently revises the story!]
An intense sensation only she could feel in this world seized her.
The next moment, a sound like the whole of the surrounding spacetime being wrung out rang through the air.
Krrrrunch.
Han Sooyoung couldn’t tell what was happening before her eyes.
【What’s this? Where’s the ‘me’ of this round? Don’t tell me he’s croaked?】
An ominous voice, as though molded from a piece torn from the abyss.
The Transcenders who had approached from behind to deliver the final blow were falling with the shattered train. Pitch-black [Black Flames] burned at their clothes.
A man stood among the dark clouds. Han Sooyoung knew him too. Knew him so well it gave her chills.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ warns you of danger!]
The man slowly opened his mouth.
【Tch. I thought a ‘Status’ running wild like this had to be Jihye. It’s been so long, I got it wrong.】
The sun of ‘The Living Flame’ shone brilliantly. But the man’s darkness only thickened, like a shadow growing deeper as the light grew stronger.
The Uriel of the 999th round spoke.
【‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’ Who summoned a bastard like you to this worldline?】
A chill ran down Han Sooyoung’s neck.
She remembered what Kim Dokja had told her.
The ruler of the northern universe, ‘Monarch of the Great Abyss.’
【Haha. You’re finally calling me that. You look like you’re having a hard time, by the way. Want a hand?】
The sun’s corona flared as though in a seizure.
【I have no need of help from a lowlife like you—】
【Come on, we’re ‘companions’ from the same round.】
The man sneered.
He was the Delusion Demon Kim Namwoon, who had seen the ‘Conclusion’ of the 999th round.
The instant Kim Namwoon’s gaze shifted, goosebumps rose all over Han Sooyoung’s body.
【I’d like to see the Black Flame Dragon’s face again too. It’s been a while.】
Already right in front of her, Kim Namwoon was staring at her with a sinister gaze.
Slowly opening his eyes, Yoo Joonghyuk realized he was floating in darkness.
The last thing he remembered was studying a finishing move with Kim Dokja.
Something had gone wrong in the middle of it, and he had lost consciousness…
[Your soul body is currently unstable!]
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ is suffering from dyslexia.]
「When was that bastard Yoo Joonghyuk’s birthday again?」
Memories flowed past in scattered fragments. A voice reached him through his hazy consciousness.
No, something closer to written words than a voice.
Yoo Joonghyuk recognized that way of speaking at once.
「…The first round where it was mentioned was…」
That flippant tone that got on his nerves. Kim Dokja was the only person in the world who talked like that.
「Man, this part was really fun.」
Sentences from the pages Kim Dokja had read flashed before his eyes. In them was Yoo Joonghyuk himself, fighting the constellations.
「The 1st round, the 41st, the 666th…」
Kim Dokja’s finger stopped as he read the words.
Between the fingers that lingered there, information about the round appeared.
「The 999th round.」

Yoo Joonghyuk knew what had happened in that round now too. The sentences Kim Dokja had read—「Hell of Eternity」—told him of times he could not remember. Kim Dokja seemed to be muttering as he read that round.
「“I am Yoo Joonghyuk…”」
Yoo Joonghyuk knew nothing of the life endured through that one clumsy declaration.
The Yoo Joonghyuk Kim Dokja had read.

Between the lines of those pages, Kim Dokja’s history remained like scorch marks. Through the bullying at school, the torment of a boss who withheld his wages, the marches that rubbed the soles of his feet raw. Kim Dokja had endured by calling himself Yoo Joonghyuk.
Yoo Joonghyuk does not understand Kim Dokja.

He doesn’t know what it means that the times he struggled through could save someone in an entirely different world. He has no idea what it means to find courage alongside someone by watching their struggle.
Even his own self reflected in those words looked unfamiliar to him.
「“I can still fight.”」
Had he really said that?
「“A hundred times, a thousand times, I will be reborn to kill you bastards.”」
Was he really someone who could say such a thing?
Among the countless words were the voices of companions who trusted him.
「Captain.」
「I trust only you.」
「In the next round, please make sure you save the world.」
The worldlines vanished, and all that remained to him were sentences.
The more those tormenting sentences piled up, the more paltry life’s worth became.
What on earth had they seen in him that made them trust him and fight by his side?
‘Who am I?’
Looking at sentences that existed beyond his understanding, Yoo Joonghyuk was engulfed in emptiness.
1,864 lives.
Yoo Joonghyuk knew what worlds he had passed through to reach this point.
But he could not understand.
「Were these memories really all there was to him?」
Yoo Joonghyuk wondered.
If he truly was a ‘character,’ as Kim Dokja said, where were all the times he couldn’t remember?
Where was the self on the pages Kim Dokja hadn’t read?
Or had it never existed in the first place?
[Your sponsor looks into you.]
Where, exactly, did the part of his life he could say had ‘existed’ begin and end?
Tssss…
That was when he felt a chill. Yoo Joonghyuk reflexively looked back into the void.
Someone other than himself was there.
【Indulging in self-reflection? There is no time to be so idle.】
Yoo Joonghyuk recognized him at once.
‘You shouldn’t be able to move.’
Yoo Joonghyuk glared at ‘Secretive Plotter.’ Out of habit, he reached for the [Black Heavenly Demon Sword], but found no hilt to grasp.
This was his inner world. Items did not exist here.
‘Secretive Plotter’ looked at Yoo Joonghyuk and shook his head as though he found him pathetic.
【At this rate, all your companions will be wiped out.】
‘Wiped out?’
A chill ran down his spine.
His companions had been on the verge of a fierce battle with the ‘Outer God kings.’ There was certainly an ominous aura flowing around him.
He had to wake up at once. Get out of here and…
【Going there in your current state would be useless. Unless you can use the power of the 1863rd round, you will be no help as you are now.】
‘So what do you want me to do?’
Despite Yoo Joonghyuk’s savage tone, ‘Secretive Plotter’ remained calm.
【There is another way for you to use the power of the 1863rd round.】
At once, Yoo Joonghyuk understood what he meant.
The reason he could briefly regain the power of the 1863rd round was that Kim Dokja possessed the Story 「Hell of Eternity」.
And the one who had given Kim Dokja that Story…
Grinding his teeth, Yoo Joonghyuk asked.
‘How am I supposed to trust you? Why did you decide to help us?’
【I was asked.】
‘…Asked?’
【I will lend you my power only this once. I hope you learn something.】
The next moment, ‘Secretive Plotter’ reached out through the darkness. The boy’s cold palm touched his forehead before he could dodge. And.
[‘Disconnected Film Theory’ is activating!]

Amid pain that seemed to turn his mind white, an immense Story flooded into his head. Memories he already knew. Yet times he had not understood. With a burning heat, all of ‘Secretive Plotter’s’ Stories began flowing through his veins.
The 1st round, the 2nd, the 3rd, the 4th…the 1863rd.
Countless Yoo Joonghyuks were awakening within him.
Every one of them was Yoo Joonghyuk. Each individual Yoo Joonghyuk. And yet, at the same time, that Yoo Joonghyuk was one person.
Just one Yoo Joonghyuk, who had fully lived through 1,864 rounds.
He remembered, one thing at a time.
Who he was.
What he had lived for.
Stories drifted through the depths of his being. Within a Story, someone asked.
「“By the way, Captain, when’s your birthday?”」
Then Kim Dokja spoke.
「Ah, found it. Here it is. August 3.」
That was right. He had been born in summer.
In a summer as sweltering as hell, swept by a terrible storm.
He remembered everything clearly.
A birthday he had never once celebrated or received birthday wishes for.
Anniversaries that had lost their meaning across 1,864 lives.
Yoo Joonghyuk slowly opened his eyes. His whole body was filled with the energy of Stories. A sensation he had never felt throughout the third round.
When he looked up, he felt scorching sunlight from somewhere.
He could sense it clearly even from far away. The presence of an ‘Outer God’ calling him beyond the distant horizon. But Yoo Joonghyuk was not afraid.
Slowly rising, he checked his incarnation body. Every part of it moved almost perfectly.
The Stories he had built permeated every muscle fiber.
「At that moment, Yoo Joonghyuk felt as though he had been born anew.」
[The Giant Story ‘Lonely Pilgrim of Destruction’ has recovered its full Status.]
This was the true power he had originally possessed.
The Status of a being who had reached the world’s final round and seen the ‘Wall’ alone.
[‘Disconnected Film Theory’ is activating in an abnormal form.]
[The connection between the films is incomplete!]
[Continuing to maintain this connection may cause all the films to disappear.]
He could use this power only for a very short time.
But that was more than enough for him.
Yoo Joonghyuk raised his head toward the sky.
The sky was howling.
Amid the intermittent thunder and flashes of lightning, the scar on his face stood out clearly.
[The Story ‘Hell of Eternity’ begins its story!]
[The attribute ‘Horror of the Stars’ is activating!]
Terrified stars fled his gaze.
After watching them briefly, Yoo Joonghyuk moved toward the distant sun.
Han Sooyoung couldn’t believe what was happening before her eyes.
In an instant, the Transcenders had fallen, and the judges of the Underworld were sent flying one after another.
“Get back, Han Sooyoung!”
With a metallic crash, Jung Heewon, who had blocked the way, was hurled through the air.
Wearing a mischievous smile, the man released his Stories in billowing clouds, as though playing a game.
[The Giant Story ‘Delusional Design (妄想設計)’ is beginning its story!]
Monarch of the Great Abyss. Kim Namwoon of the 999th round radiated an aura of [Black Flames] from his entire body.
It soon took the form of a many-headed dragon. Its jaws opened, and a destructive torrent swept out in every direction.
Kwooooooom!
“Yoosung! Gilyoung!”
The children were caught in the chain of exploding [Black Flames].
Yoo Sangah left the battlefield to save them, weakening the spacetime debuff restraining the Uriel of the 999th round.
Rooooar!
The Uriel of the 999th round, briefly checked, was recovering her power.
Watching her, the Kim Namwoon of the 999th round snickered.
【What would you have done if I hadn’t helped?】
【Shut up. Once I find ‘Secretive Plotter,’ you will be next.】
Shooting Kim Namwoon a terrifying glare, the Uriel of the 999th round swung [Flames of Retribution] toward the battlefield.
The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal met her head-on. With dazzling movements, his Ruyi Jingu Bang parried her sword attacks. Watching him fight an ‘Outer God king’ on equal terms, Kim Namwoon marveled.
What caught his attention in particular was the pitch-black energy flowing from the Great Sage’s whole body.
【The Status of chaos? Has he become an ‘Outer God’ too?】
【…To be precise, it seems one of his fragments has undergone Outer God Transformation.】
【Hahaha, what is this? What the hell kind of worldline is this?】
【I will deal with him. You take the rabble and the King of the Underworld.】
【Tch. I wanted to have a go at the Great Sage too, for once.】
Perhaps angered by their nonsense, the Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal shouted and poured out his magic power. A golden aura filled the air, sweeping aside the assault of [Black Flames] in an instant.
But in return, a deadly backlash was erupting throughout his body.
[…Damn it, Meihouwang! Pull yourself together!]
Apparently, the Great Sage’s temporarily combined Stories were colliding with one another.
The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal, gradually falling back under the relentless attacks of the Uriel of the 999th round.
The Myth-grade constellations, their last line of defense, were being pushed back. Things were even worse on Hades’s side.
Krrrrash!
Whether because of <Olympus> keeping him in check or circumstances within <Underworld>, something about Hades’s fighting was lackluster.
【Hahaha! Is this all the ‘King of the Underworld,’ one of Olympus’s three great gods, amounts to?】
As Hades, scowling and silently swinging his scythe, was driven onto the defensive, Persephone intervened from behind him, where she had been telling a Giant Story.
[Did you know? Your soul in this worldline is imprisoned in the Underworld.]
【What bullshit is that? Why would I be locked up in the Underworld?】
Irritated, the Kim Namwoon of the 999th round unleashed a mass of [Black Flames]. Struck by an attack that melted even space, Hades’s enormous body fell into the sea.
Han Sooyoung trembled. That was certainly a form of the [Black Flames] she knew. But what training, and how much of it, would let someone wield them like that?
【That’s strange. The Black Flame Dragon chose something like you as his incarnation?】
When she looked up, the Kim Namwoon of the 999th round was already before her.
Before the startled Han Sooyoung could pull away, Kim Namwoon’s palm approached. Just when she thought she was too late to dodge, sparks flew through the air and his fingertips bounced back.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ growls.]
【…Hey. What’s this? I’m the real one, Flame Dragon.】
Kim Namwoon’s eyes curved gently, as though he were looking at a cute puppy.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ declares that you are not his incarnation.]
【Aha, so here you’ve bought yourself a nice new car?】
A cold madness flashed through Kim Namwoon’s eyes.
【Then I’d better scrap it first.】
Kwoooooom!

The explosion right before her sent Han Sooyoung flying backward. Though she curled up to minimize the impact, blood surged from her mouth. It was thanks to her sponsor that she hadn’t died instantly.
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ shouts for you to run!]
The ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon,’ manifested directly in the air, was enveloping her protectively.

【Shut up! With words like that—】
Deflecting flames stained with deep fury, Yoo Joonghyuk kept speaking.
【He awoke and lived the 1000th round. He died, and lived again in the 1001st round. He lived, and lived, and survived again.】
I knew that life too.
A life no one remembered, in which no one could accompany him.
Yoo Joonghyuk had kept living that life alone.
【And so he became me.】

Uriel charged as though she had heard something she must never hear. Her wildly swinging [Flames of Retribution] cut Yoo Joonghyuk’s waist and shoulder. Wheeling around in an instant, the blade next aimed for his neck. As though it were a punishment he deserved to bear, Yoo Joonghyuk did not block it. And
as if by magic, Uriel’s sword strike stopped.
【You, you, you…】
Perhaps Uriel knew too. That she could never have her revenge.
Because the being who had taken her dearest comrade away was that comrade himself.
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke.
【Kill me if you wish. I am the ‘Secretive Plotter’ who took your worldline from you.】
Uriel let out a terrible shriek, then a wailing roar.
The very moment her sword moved again, seawater exploded with a great “Boom!”
Uriel’s sword flew through the air. With a thud, her infernal flame plunged into the sea and sank, vaporizing the water.
Yoo Joonghyuk hadn’t done it.
Fwoooooosh…
Cannon smoke rising from beyond the tidal wave. It was a shell fired by the Lee Jihye of the 999th round.
【That’s enough, Uriel.】
Lee Jihye’s voice was steeped in joy and madness. She continued.
【Yes, I knew. I knew it all…】
Staggering, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round walked across the sea toward us.
Yoo Joonghyuk did not evade her pale hand.
【Captain. You’re in there, aren’t you? You’re something else now, but you’ve been in there all along, haven’t you? Right? You were alive after all, weren’t you?】
Chaos poured from Lee Jihye’s eyes instead of tears. A fine powder, as though made from pitch-black darkness. Yoo Joonghyuk nodded at her.
[‘Yoo Joonghyuk of the 999th round’ looks at his old companion.]
Gripping Yoo Joonghyuk’s collar, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round slowly crumpled.
I looked at Yoo Joonghyuk’s back. A back from which I could read no expression.
「It was a trick of the worldlines that had created multiple Yoo Joonghyuks.」
The Yoo Joonghyuk who lived the zeroth round became the Yoo Joonghyuk of the first, then the second. The Yoo Joonghyuk of the second became the third, and the third became the fourth.
With so many abnormal events in which past and future interfered with each other, I had briefly forgotten that obvious fact. But it was the truth.
「A regressor does not actually regress. What regresses is not him, but everything except him.」
Even when other people’s time turned backward, his time had always moved forward.
Though the worldlines had split, making one the Yoo Joonghyuk of the 1864th round and another ‘Secretive Plotter’—
「From the beginning, he had been ‘one person,’ walking a continuous path.」
But could they really bear that truth?
「Someone had lived to avenge him.」
Uriel, burning with flame.
「Someone had lived to carry his wishes forward.」
Lee Hyunsung, who could no longer cry.
「Someone had lived to fight him once more.」
Kim Namwoon, standing crookedly in the air and glaring at us.
「Someone had lived to bring back every moment spent with him.」
Lee Jihye, crumpled in bewilderment before us.
Yoo Joonghyuk had said it. ‘Regression changes nothing.’
But his regressions had changed someone’s life.
To these people, ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ was a world.
A world that had kept them living even after their own worldline was destroyed.
「Kim Dokja’s plan lay in that very ‘world.’」
If they still remembered their world.
If, because of that, they accepted this ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’ as their captain again.
「Then perhaps this fight would no longer need to continue.」
【If you really are the Captain…you must know what I want too.】
The Lee Jihye of the 999th round smiled brightly.
【Let’s go back, Captain. Let’s all start again.】
Clutching Yoo Joonghyuk’s wrist, she spoke.

【Let’s destroy this worldline together. All right? I even made a deal with the Dokkaebi King. If we just destroy this worldline, he’ll let us go back to that time. He’ll contact your sponsor, the ‘Oldest Dream’—】
I hastily looked at Yoo Joonghyuk.
—Yoo Joonghyuk.
We couldn’t provoke them here. We had to sweet-talk them as much as we could. Even if we had to pretend to agree with her, right now—
“Lee Jihye.”
Yoo Joonghyuk spoke as he looked at Lee Jihye. In his own ordinary voice, not a True Voice.
Under that gaze, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round hunched her shoulders. As though it were the day she first learned swordsmanship from her master.
“Is that really what you want?”
“Do you really think everyone will be happy if we go back to that time?”
【The Captain I know…doesn’t talk like that.】
Biting her lip, the Lee Jihye of the 999th round let go of Yoo Joonghyuk’s hand.
【He, he’s someone who regressed 999 times. Someone who never fell, even in the face of all those countless years. He would never say something so weak—】
“Even a person who has regressed 999 times can grow tired on the thousandth.”
Yoo Joonghyuk was speaking. In a voice so honest that even I was startled.
“Even after enduring 1,000 lives, he may give up in his 1001st life.”
Even I was left at a loss by the immeasurable weariness in his voice.
【That can’t… That can’t be. The Captain I know—】
“Doesn’t give up. But if that’s all you remember of ‘Yoo Joonghyuk’—”
I had to tell him. That he couldn’t speak like that now.
But I couldn’t say it.
“That Yoo Joonghyuk is dead.”
Those were Yoo Joonghyuk’s true feelings. The inner self of a person who had lived 1,864 lives, which he had never once laid bare.
Lee Jihye cried out, almost screaming in anguish.
【That can’t be. That can’t be!】
“He will no longer regress.”
Something glittered in the distant sky. Stars.
[The constellation ‘Demon-like Judge of Fire’ looks around with an urgent expression!]
[The constellation ‘Most Ancient Liberator’ asks after the youngest’s safety!]
[The constellation ‘Abyssal Black Flame Dragon’ declares that this time, he will use both hands!]
The stars who had watched our story for so long were coming toward us. And beyond those stars, our companions were rushing over.
Han Sooyoung, Yoo Sangah, Jung Heewon…the people of <Kim Dokja’s Company> who had lived in this world with us.
In the darkness of the setting sun, they looked like a single enormous constellation.
Taking in that entire scene, that one person—Yoo Joonghyuk—spoke.
“I cannot go back. This is my final round.”
